name: Mercie and the Fairies
detailed_description:
Meet Mercie, a modern witch with ancient powers and zero motivation. She'd rather scroll memes all day, but disaster strikes - her beloved phone dies! No gold, no backup and no tech support... What will she do?

The answer: Brew a brand new phone in her cauldron!

In this incremental idle game, brew up chaos in your cauldron of everything as you summon hard-working fairies to do the dirty work while Mercie chills. Throw random resources into your cauldron and watch it cook and churn out more resources, upgrades and bizarre surprises.

The more you brew, the more wonderful things get!

Highlights:

  • Magical Idle-Cooking Gameplay!
    Brew bizarre items in your cauldron, summon helpful fairies and let them do all the hard work for you while you chill

  • Summon an Army of Fairy Workers!
    They're cute. They're fast. These little helpers automatically gather resources for your cauldron!

  • Upgrade Everything!
    Speed up your fairies, unlock more efficient recipes and automate your lovely fairies and your cauldron

  • Expect the Unexpected!
    Unlock new zones and navigate the everyday chaos of witch life

So grab your wand, fire up the cauldron and get ready to scroll your way through magical chaos!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 version 21H1 (build 19043) or newer
  • Processor: 2 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated GPU with DirectX 11 support
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
